_comment: The local Bank environment, identical on every PC. Machine-specific values live in machines/<COMPUTERNAME>.json and nowhere else.
_comment_claude_code_cli: SESSION mode only: "auto" = a Preview interprets a new rule by itself through the Claude Code CLI installed on this PC (same login as the VS Code session, no AWS); "off" = the Preview waits for the session as before (BANK_AI_RULES_012).
